identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime][Observatory][bug] Restore complete conversation transcripts from Runtime history

values.task_boundary: Repair complete conversation restoration only; preserve provider, agent-to-agent, and live deployment behavior.
deliverables: privacy redaction pagination replay and deduplication enforcement
focused deterministic Runtime and Observatory tests
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: conversation_history.v1 exposes the operator outbound turn and corresponding generated reply in deterministic order with stable identity.
AC-2: A fresh Observatory load invokes Runtime history restoration and renders both ordered halves exactly once.
AC-3: Replay from history and live frames cannot duplicate restored turns.
AC-4: Authorization revocation privacy redaction and bounded page/history limits fail closed.

AC-5: An isolated end-to-end acceptance submits operator text, obtains an agent reply through production paths, discards UI state, restores from conversation_history.v1, and proves both halves exactly once.
AC-6: Focused Runtime and Observatory tests, formatter, contract checks, and exact-range diff hygiene pass.
AC-7: Independent exact-head review passes and a non-draft PR is published without merge.
dependencies: #278 history API and Observatory restoration intent
non_goals: Permanent Wuji Runtime restart or mutation
